note: Marinette County park on the High Falls Flowage of the Peshtigo River, about 15 miles northwest of Crivitz: three wooded loops, with a swim beach, dog beach, boat mooring and a rock overlook on the flowage. --Claude
summary: County campground page, 2027 fee schedule, reservation policy and 2019 park map read; imagery checked. 2027: $35 (Tue/Wed $30), 50A sites 9/14/38/47 $45, $10 reservation fee, 2.5% card fee; 62 electric sites + group site; showers/flush/water/dump; May 1 - Oct 15; reservable only (184 days), 14-night max. Lakeview kept but weak.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakeview' (not --AWH) kept but WEAK: no site is on open ground near water. All three loops are under continuous forest. Closest to water are Inlet loop sites 38-42 (~45.318,-88.193), about 30-50 m from a narrow (~25-40 m) inlet channel through trees, and Overlook loop sites 9-12, about 60 m from the flowage behind woods; the beach and mooring area lie between the Overlook loop and the open flowage. A downgrade to 'not waterfront' is defensible if no site has a view in leaf-on; no site photos read.
PHONE 715-732-7530 confirmed (Facilities & Parks office). WEBSITE unchanged (live; it is also the booking page).
ATV: the page carries an 'ATV/UTV Usage in Marinette County Parks' notice (details not read). This is a general county campground, not an OHV staging camp: flag only.
STATUS: open seasonally May 1 - Oct 15; county policy says no county campground opens before May 1 or stays open past November 30.
PIN 45.3156,-88.1949 falls on the Overlook loop roads: fine.
